label: ENDLESS_TEMPORAL_DURATION_2, contrast…: Duration with an unending succession of earlier and later…
definition: Duration with an unending succession of earlier and later moments. This permits succession and therefore differs from eternity, which has no succession and is all at once.
note: A stipulated contrast only; no temporal model or perpetually existing thing is asserted. A pinned account of temporal perpetuity would be needed before using it as a premise. The distinction is motivated by q.10 a.1’s account of time and eternity. Declaration-completion audit and explicit endpoint alternatives (owner decision pending): corpus/definitions/endless-temporal-duration-audit.md. Existing EndlessLife permits finite timelines and is not a faithful direct binding.
